This stage is a first working session in R and in Quarto, on the data of the case study. It ends with the paper of the original authors (OAs) and the first sections of the background page, and takes about five hours.

## 1. R on the data of the case study {#r-on-the-data-of-the-case}

[Open Getting started with R at section 6](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html#sec-reading){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Work from [Reading the data](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html#sec-reading) to [A first figure](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html#sec-figure) in the module on the umbrella site, then read [The helpers of the workspace](../../companion/helpers.qmd) on this site. Type each block into the workspace rather than pasting it. Keep a script of your own that reads `housing_emails.csv`, counts the replies with a greeting code and the greetings by name for each group of names, and draws one figure from those counts.

## 2. Quarto

[Open Quarto documents](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/quarto.html#sec-what){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Work from [Source and output](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/quarto.html#sec-what) to [Citations](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/quarto.html#sec-citations) in the module on the umbrella site. Write and render a Quarto document of your own that holds your figure, a cross-reference to it and a citation. Then render the report of the workspace, `index.qmd`, once, and read through the five tasks that you will fill in.

## 3. The paper

[Open the accepted manuscript](https://hdl.handle.net/2144/37826){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Read the whole article of the OAs [@EinsteinGlick2017DoesRaceAffect], in the accepted manuscript to which the page numbers of the background page refer. Then find the third model of Table 1, and the sentence of the abstract from which the claim was taken.

## 4. Background {#the-case-study}

[Read the background](../../background.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Read sections 1 to 3: [the original study](../../background.qmd#sec-study), [SCORE](../../background.qmd#sec-score) and its robustness study [Multi100\; @AczelEtAl2026InvestigatingAnalyticalRobustness], and [the five reanalyses](../../background.qmd#sec-reanalysts). Then write the claim of the case study in your own words.

**Shortcuts.** If you already write R with the tidyverse, read the section on the datawizard verbs, which the course uses wherever they do the job, and the section on `try_spec()`, and run the rest only where its output surprises you. If you already write Quarto, render the report of the workspace and move on.
